label: Local causal record condition: LocalRecord h v: edges at v hold between existents at v; each…
definition: LocalRecord h v: edges at v hold between existents at v (Sound); each existent at v has an edge as effect or as cause (Recorded); and x is present at time t at v iff x exists at v (Perpetual). tableTruth is the named edge table as a #736 reason-vector.
note: Recorded is weaker than every member having a cause: a source with an effect passes, a causally idle existent does not. Perpetual is a restriction of the fixtures and of the table theorems; the dated control violates it. Causal edges are supplied, not certified as genuine causes.
